scripts.docker:test: NODE_ENV=test npx sequelize-cli db:migrate && NODE_ENV=test npx sequelize-cli db:seed:all && NODE_ENV=test vitest run --no-file-parallelism
scripts.test: docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml up --build --abort-on-container-exit --exit-code-from app-test; docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml down -v --rmi all --remove-orphans
scripts.seed: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml exec app npx sequelize-cli db:seed:all
scripts.migrate: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml exec app npx sequelize-cli db:migrate
scripts.seed:undo: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml exec app npx sequelize-cli db:seed:undo:all
scripts.migrate:undo: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml exec app npx sequelize-cli db:migrate:undo:all
